correctness.rationale: PASS: Veniani Q56 Section 5.2 defines irreducible f(p)=p^4-p^3+2p²+p+1 and q=(p-1)/(p+1). Independently checked irreducibility over Q, exact root-permutation identities f(-1/p)=f(p)/p^4 and f((1-p)/(1+p))=4f(p)/(1+p)^4 and f((1+p)/(p-1))=4f(p)/(p-1)^4; these commute as a Klein-four group. s=2p-1-2/p satisfies s²=-15 modulo f and is fixed by p↦-1/p. Over Q(s), f splits into quadratics with discriminants a=(1+s)/2 and its conjugate; adjoining u²=a and v=2/u gives (u+v)²=5, (u-v)²=-3. The extension is Q(sqrt5,sqrt(-3)), with relative involution fixing Q(sqrt(-15)). The quartic coefficient groups scale identically under (p,q)↦(-1/p,-1/q). No claim of minimal field for each line or Galois action on labeled 56 lines. Independent exact SymPy polynomial-rem checks and inspected source verify identities.
